records.observation: Daily Telegraph early mail reports the Roosters may receive Sam Walker back from ankle surgery for Week 2. This conflicts with the earlier official Finals Week 1 state that had Walker unavailable for the remainder of 2026.
records.source: Daily Telegraph NRL Finals Early Mail, 13 Sep 2026

records.observation: Daily Telegraph early mail reports Trent Robinson is less optimistic about Crichton's return from his foot injury for Week 2.
records.source: Daily Telegraph NRL Finals Early Mail, 13 Sep 2026

records.observation: Early mail reports Trindall is managing a shoulder issue but is expected to play. Sharks official reporting confirms he returned from a shoulder injury and played in the Week 1 win over North Queensland.
records.source: Daily Telegraph early mail + Sharks official Week 1 match report

records.observation: Early mail reports Mulitalo is managing a hand issue but is expected to play Week 2.
records.source: Daily Telegraph NRL Finals Early Mail, 13 Sep 2026

records.observation: Early mail reports Lucas could return from an ankle dislocation for Week 2. No directional production uplift is assigned before official selection and workload evidence.
records.source: Daily Telegraph NRL Finals Early Mail, 13 Sep 2026

records.observation: Early mail reports Newcastle is monitoring Frizell's hamstring and expects him to be available.
records.source: Daily Telegraph NRL Finals Early Mail, 13 Sep 2026

integrity: Early-mail signals only. No Week 2 roster identity, availability state, tip, confidence or frozen decision is created from these reports. Sam Walker is explicitly retained as a contradiction against the prior official OUT_FOR_SEASON state pending newer official confirmation.
